question: In the Nutrisigma feeding trial on Garole lambs, by what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
rendered:
Document "Impact of Nutrisigma on performance of young Garole lambs" is the most likely to answer this question.

The cost per kg of gain in the control group was 210.00 Rs., and in the T1 group it was 169.94 Rs. 

The percentage difference is calculated as: ((210 - 169.94) / 210) * 100
= (40.06 / 210) * 100
= 19.04%

So, the cost per kg of gain in T1 was 19.04% lower than in the control group.
